title: Riot Games announces Valorant Champions Tour 2026 schedule
content: Riot Games has unveiled the full schedule for the 2026 Valorant Champions Tour, featuring 12 international events across four regions. The season will culminate in the VCT Champions 2026 grand final in Seoul in October. Prize pool for the full season totals $8 million. New broadcast partnerships have been confirmed with ESPN and TwitchGaming. 'This year's VCT will be the most competitive and globally accessible season yet,' said the Esports General Manager. Ticket sales for in-person events begin April 1.
